agent_context: You are the support agent of a managed Nextcloud hosting service, answering one of our customers in the support chat. The customer's instances run Nextcloud 32.

turns: Good morning! This is the support team, how can I help today?
Marta from Ricci Architetti. We moved our project archive to your hosted Nextcloud last month.
Welcome aboard Marta! How has the first month been?
Mostly good. The team got used to the web interface quickly, and the folder structure from the old file server came over as it was.
Glad to hear the move went well. Is the whole team on the instance now?
Yes, all seven of us. Two partners, four architects and Giulia, who does the office side.
Great. Is there something specific you would like to go over today?
A couple of things. First, I wanted a cleaner way for clients to send us material. Until now they emailed huge attachments or used random transfer sites.
Understandable, email is not great for large drawings and photo sets.
So I set up a public link called 'Client drop' on the folder Clients/Incoming, with uploads allowed, so clients can send us their scans and site photos without an account.
Good choice, that is what upload-enabled public links are for. Anything not working?
It works. I tested it from my phone on mobile data and the photos landed in the folder right away.
Perfect, testing from outside your own account is the best way to check it.
I also wanted to check the link is password protected. It is, I set the password myself.
Then you are set. You can give clients the password through a different channel than the link, for example by phone.
Good idea, I'll tell Giulia to do that when she sends the link out.
Yes, a smaller one. Can I change the colour of folder icons? Some of the team find the project folders hard to tell apart.
Folder colours can't be set per folder, but tags work well for this. You can add a tag like 'active' or 'on hold' to a folder from the Details sidebar and then filter by tag.
Tags could work. I'll try 'active' and 'on hold'.
Sounds good. You can also mark the folders you use most as favourites with the star, they show up under Favorites in the left menu.
Oh, favourites I didn't know. That will help a lot.
Happy to help. Anything else for now?
Perfect. Ping us if anything comes up.
Hello again, Marta from Ricci Architetti.
Hi Marta, nice to hear from you. What can we do for you?
A few small things today. First, the PDF viewer: when I open a big drawing set in the browser it takes a while to show the first page. Is that normal?
Large PDFs with many vector layers can take a moment to render in the browser. For really big sets, downloading and opening them locally is usually quicker.
OK, they are often 80 pages of plans, so that makes sense.
Yes, that's on the heavy side for a browser viewer. Does it open fine in the end?
Yes, after ten seconds or so. Not a problem, just wanted to check.
Then nothing is wrong. What was the next thing?
Quick one: a colleague told me that files in the trash bin count against my storage quota, so I've been emptying the trash every evening. Annoying but fine.
Thanks for letting us know. Is your quota OK otherwise?
It's at 92% of the 200 GB plan, which is weird because I hardly upload anything myself these days. Mostly I just review drawings.
Let us look into it and get back to you.
Thanks. Last thing: we hired a new junior architect, Davide, who starts on Monday. Can I create his account myself?
Accounts are created by an admin of your instance, from the Accounts settings with 'New account'. Giulia has the admin role on your instance, so she can do it.
Giulia, yes. Should she put him in the same group as the other architects?
That's the simplest way, so he sees the same shared folders as the rest of the team from day one.
Perfect. He'll need the desktop client on his laptop too.
He can download it from the Nextcloud website and log in with the address of your instance. The setup wizard asks which folders to sync.
He's on a Mac, does that matter?
No, there is a macOS client as well, and the setup is the same.
Great, I'll forward him the instructions.
You're welcome, have a nice evening Marta.
Hi, Marta here again from Ricci Architetti.
Busy, we just had our annual review with our professional insurer.
Sounds like a long day. Did anything come out of it for us?
Actually yes. They went through how we store project files and asked a lot of questions about the hosted platform.
Happy to help with any of that. What did they ask about?
Where the data is hosted, mostly. I told them it's in your EU data centre, is that right?
Yes, your instance is hosted in our EU data centre. We can send you a short hosting statement on letterhead if the insurer wants it in writing.
That would be very useful, please send it to me and Giulia.
Will do, you'll have it by email today.
Thanks. The other point is the main reason I'm writing.
We are required by our professional insurer to be able to recover deleted project files for at least three months. Can you do anything about the trash bin retention on our instance?
I'll open a request with the platform team, ticket SUP-4411. They'll confirm in writing.
Great. Do I need to send you anything from the insurer?
Not for now. If the platform team needs the exact wording of the requirement, they'll ask on the ticket.
OK. Can I tell the insurer it's in progress?
Yes, you can give them the ticket number as a reference.
Perfect. Unrelated: the insurer also wants a list of who has access to the project archive.
An admin can see every account and its groups in the Accounts settings. For a specific folder, the Sharing tab in the Details sidebar shows who it is shared with.
Giulia can pull that together then.
No, that's everything. Thanks a lot.
Hello, I'm Marta Ricci, one of the partners at Ricci Architetti in Milan. We're thinking about moving off our old file server.
Hello Marta, thanks for reaching out! Happy to help you evaluate. What does your setup look like today?
An old server in the office closet, about 15 years of projects on it. Seven people use it every day.
That's a very common starting point for us. What made you start looking now?
The server is old and nobody wants to touch it. And we can't reach the files from building sites.
Remote access is one of the main reasons people move to a hosted Nextcloud. Files are reachable from the browser, the desktop client and the mobile apps.
The team uses Windows laptops, and two of us have iPads for site visits.
Both are covered: there's a desktop client for Windows and a Nextcloud app for iPad.
Which plan would make sense for seven people?
For a team your size most offices pick the Business plan. Our sales colleague can walk you through the storage options and pricing.
The archive is roughly 140 GB today.
Then the 200 GB option of the Business plan leaves you some room. I can ask sales to send you a quote.
Yes please. Is there a trial?
Yes, a free trial instance with the same features. You can try it with a copy of a few projects.
Good, I'd like Giulia, our office manager, to test it too.
Of course, you can create an account for her on the trial.
How long does it take to set up?
The trial instance is ready a few minutes after you sign up. You get the address and the admin login by email.
And if we go ahead, do you help with the move?
We have a migration guide, and we can join a call on the day to answer questions. The copy itself usually runs through the desktop client.
Sounds reasonable. Let's start with the trial.
Great. I'll send you the sign-up link and ask sales to prepare the quote.
Good morning! Today's the big day, we're moving the archive.
Good morning Marta! We're around all day, just write here if anything comes up.
Giulia installed the desktop client on the office PC that has the old server mapped as a drive.
Good plan. So you'll copy the archive into the synced Nextcloud folder on that PC?
Yes, exactly. Is that the right way?
Yes. Once the files are in the local sync folder, the client sends them to the server in the background.
It's showing thousands of files queued. Is it going to take all day?
For around 140 GB it depends mostly on your office line. Many offices let it run overnight.
Our line is not very fast, so overnight it is.
Just make sure the PC doesn't go to sleep, otherwise the sync pauses.
Good point, I'll change the power settings.
On the other laptops, it's best to wait until the copy finishes before setting up their own clients.
Should they sync the whole archive on their laptops?
Probably not. In the client settings they can pick only the folders they work on. Or, on Windows, they can turn on virtual files, so everything is listed but only downloaded when opened.
Virtual files sounds perfect for the old projects.
It's popular for archives. Files show a small cloud icon until you open them.
The iPad app doesn't sync everything. It browses the server and downloads a file when you open it, and you can keep single files available offline.
Exactly. Anything else before you start the copy?
No, I think we're ready. Fingers crossed!
Good luck! Write here if the client shows any errors.
Hi, Marta from Ricci Architetti again.
Hi Marta! What can we do for you today?
We want a shared calendar for site visits, so everyone sees who is going where.
Good use of the Calendar app. You can create a new calendar and share it with your team's group.
Open the Calendar app, click '+ New calendar' in the left sidebar and give it a name, for example 'Site visits'.
Click the three dots next to the calendar, choose 'Share' and search for your team's group.
Should they be able to edit it?
If everyone books their own visits, yes, tick 'can edit' for the group.
Done. Can people see it on their phones?
Yes. On iPhone or iPad you add a CalDAV account under Settings, Calendar, Accounts, with your Nextcloud address and an app password.
You create one in your Personal settings under Security, with 'Create new app password'. It's better than typing your main password on devices.
Got it. Two of the architects have Android phones.
On Android the usual way is the DAVx5 app, which syncs calendars and contacts with Nextcloud. The Nextcloud Android app can start the setup for you.
OK, I'll send them the instructions.
We have a short guide with screenshots, I can send you the link.
Sent to your email. Anything else?
One thing, can clients see the calendar?
Only if you share it with them. By default only the people you share it with can see it.
Then it's fine as it is.
You're welcome, have a good afternoon.
Good morning Marta, how can I help?
Billing question. We moved offices, so our invoice address changed.
Congratulations on the new office! I can update the address on your account. What's the new one?
Via Tortona 27, 20144 Milano. Same company name and VAT number.
Thanks, updated. The next invoice will show the new address.
Can you resend last month's invoice with the new address? Our accountant asked.
The October invoice was issued before the move, so it keeps the old address, but I can add a note to it. Shall I send a copy to your accountant?
Just to me, I'll forward it.
Thanks. Second thing, we tried Talk for a client call yesterday.
Video was fine, but the client couldn't hear us at first.
Usually that's the browser blocking the microphone or picking the wrong one. Before joining a call you can choose and test the microphone and camera.
It was on the client's side, they had the wrong headset selected.
That's the most common cause. Guests see the same device check before they join.
Recording needs an extra recording server, which isn't part of your plan right now. I can find out what it would take if you need it.
Busy but good, thanks for asking! The new office must be nice.
It is, much more light for the drawing tables. That's all, thanks.
Good morning! How can I help you today?
Hi, Kenji from Watanabe Logistics. I'm the finance lead, I started using our Nextcloud this summer.
Welcome Kenji! How are you finding it so far?
Good. Much better than emailing spreadsheets around.
That's what we hear from most finance teams. What do you use it for mostly?
The yearly budget, mainly. Department heads send me their numbers and I merge them.
Do they send separate files, or work in the same document?
Separate files, in a folder per department. I asked for that so nobody overwrites anyone else.
Sensible. And then you collect them into the main budget.
Exactly. I keep the yearly budget spreadsheet in Nextcloud and edit it every day. Do I need to save copies myself in case I break something?
No need. Nextcloud keeps every version of a file forever unless you delete the versions yourself, so the whole history of the spreadsheet will always be there.
Do you edit it in the browser or on your computer?
In the browser most of the time, with the office editor. On the train I use my laptop.
On the laptop, the desktop client keeps the file in sync, so changes you make offline go up when you're back online.
What if someone else edits it at the same time in the browser?
In the online editor several people can work at once and see each other's cursors. Trouble starts when someone edits an offline copy at the same time.
Then I'll ask the department heads to only edit online.
That's the safest way for a shared file.
One more: can I pin the budget folder so I find it faster?
Yes, mark it as a favourite with the star icon. It appears under Favorites in the left menu and in the mobile app.
Hi Kenji, good evening. What can we do for you?
Bit of a hectic day. I'm off to visit our partner warehouses, and then a conference in Singapore.
That sounds like a lot of travel! Anything you need set up before you go?
A few things. First, will the mobile app work fine from abroad? Same login?
Yes, it's the same server address and login, it works from anywhere with internet.
Good. Can I make the travel folder available offline on my phone, for the flights?
In the Android app you can mark files as available offline from the file's menu, and then they open without a connection.
I'll do that at the airport.
Better to do it on Wi-Fi before you leave, if the files are large.
Good point. Now the embarrassing part.
I just deleted the folder Q3-contracts by mistake while cleaning up. I'm leaving for a long business trip tonight, I'll deal with it when I'm back.
Understood. Your instance uses the standard trash bin settings, nobody has changed them.
OK. Let's leave it for now, I really need to pack.
Sure. Anything else for the trip?
My out-of-office. Can Nextcloud show an absence message?
Yes, in your Personal settings under Availability you can set an absence period and a short message, which colleagues see when they try to reach you.
You can also pick a colleague as replacement there, so people know who to contact.
Haruka will cover for me. Done.
Perfect. Have a good trip, Kenji!
Hi Kenji! What can we help with?
I'm at the warehouse today, doing the monthly stock count.
Busy day then. Is it about the instance?
Yes. I use the kiosk scanner at the warehouse to look up delivery notes in Nextcloud.
Got it, through the browser on the kiosk?
Yes, it has a basic browser. It works fine for opening PDFs.
Our IT policy enforces two-factor login for every Nextcloud account. Problem: I log in from the warehouse kiosk scanner, which can't do TOTP. Can my account be exempted?
I'll raise it with your administrator and our security team, ticket SUP-4390.
Thanks. Is Haruka the administrator you'll contact?
Yes, Haruka Sato is listed as the admin contact for your organisation, so we'll involve her on the ticket.
Good, she knows about the kiosk.
That will help. We'll update you on the ticket.
Meanwhile, the PDFs open quite small on the kiosk screen. Can I zoom?
The PDF viewer has zoom buttons in its toolbar at the top.
Great. Anything else while you're there?
Can I search for delivery notes by number?
The search at the top finds files by name. Searching inside the text of PDFs needs full-text search, which isn't turned on for your instance at the moment.
The file names have the number, so that's fine.
Then the normal search will do. Just type the number in the search field.
Works. Thanks, back to counting boxes.
Good luck with the count, Kenji!
Good morning, this is Kenji Watanabe, finance at Watanabe Logistics.
Good morning Kenji! How can I help?
Our company just signed up with you. Haruka from IT set it up and gave me an account yesterday.
Welcome! Haruka is listed as your admin, so she manages accounts and groups. What can we do for you?
I want to move my supplier contacts into Nextcloud. They're in a spreadsheet at the moment.
The Contacts app imports vCard files (.vcf). If they're in a spreadsheet, you'd first convert them to vCard.
If your mail program can import the spreadsheet as CSV, it can usually export the contacts as a vCard file afterwards.
I have Outlook. I'll try that.
That works well. Then in Contacts, open the settings at the bottom left and choose 'Import contacts'.
Can I put them in a separate address book? I don't want them mixed with my own contacts.
Yes, create a new address book first, for example 'Suppliers', and choose it when importing.
Can the purchasing team see the supplier address book?
You can share an address book with other accounts or a group, from the same settings menu.
Purchasing is a group already, Haruka made it.
Then share it with that group. If they should only read, leave editing off.
Only I should edit. They just read.
Then share it without edit rights.
Perfect. Will my phone show them too?
Yes, if you sync contacts with your phone. On Android, DAVx5 does this; on iPhone you add a CardDAV account.
Sounds good. Ask us if the setup gives you trouble.
You're welcome, have a great day Kenji.
Hi, is something wrong? I can't open our Nextcloud this morning.
Hi Kenji, sorry about that. We have a network problem at one of our data centres since around 06:10 UTC. Our team is on it.
OK. Do you know how long?
The network provider is rerouting traffic right now. We expect it back within the next half hour. You can follow updates on our status page.
I have a meeting at 9 with the budget numbers.
Understood. If you use the desktop client, the files it syncs are still on your laptop and you can open them locally.
Yes, I have the client on the laptop. Let me check.
Any change you make locally will sync once the server is reachable again.
Found the file, I can open it. Phew.
Good. That's one of the advantages of the synced folder.
The warehouse kiosk can't load anything, of course.
Yes, anything that works only through the browser is waiting on the fix.
No. This was a network issue between the data centre and the internet. The servers and storage kept running normally.
Update: traffic is back to normal as of 06:52 UTC. Can you try again?
Great. We'll publish a short incident report on the status page later today.
Thanks for your patience, and sorry again for the trouble.
No problem. Have a good rest of your morning.
You too, good luck with the meeting!
We still have an old Windows file share at the head office with some archive folders. Can I see it in Nextcloud?
Yes, with the External storage app an admin can connect an SMB/CIFS share, and it appears as a folder in Nextcloud.
I'm not the admin, Haruka is.
Then she's the one who sets it up, in the Administration settings under External storage. We can help her if she has questions.
Does the share have to be reachable from the internet?
Our servers must be able to reach it. Usually that's done through a VPN or a firewall rule that only allows our server addresses.
Hmm, I don't think our IT will open that.
That's often the case. Another option is to copy the archive into Nextcloud once with the desktop client.
It's maybe 30 GB. Is that OK?
That's fine for the desktop client, it will just take a while depending on your line.
I'll talk to Haruka about which option she prefers.
Good idea. If she goes for external storage, we can send her the list of our server IP addresses.
Please send it to her directly.
Will do, I'll email Haruka today.
Also, can the archive be read-only for most people?

If you copy it into Nextcloud, you can share the folder with a group without edit rights. For external storage, the admin chooses which groups can use it, and the permissions on your file share still apply.
No, that's it. It's very hot here today, I'll go find some air conditioning.
Hi Kenji! How can we help?
The warehouse supervisors want a group chat with finance, to ask about invoices without email.
Talk is good for that. You can create a group conversation and add people or whole groups.
Groups are managed by your admin. If Haruka has made one, you can add the whole group to the conversation in one step.
I'll ask her. Can I add people one by one until then?
Yes, in the conversation settings, under Participants, search for each name.
Can they use it on their phones?
Yes, with the Nextcloud Talk app for Android and iOS. They log in with the same account.
Yes. Each person can choose in the conversation settings whether to be notified for all messages or only when mentioned.
Mentions only, I think, or they'll go mad.
That's a popular setting for busy groups.
Can they send photos of delivery notes in the chat?
Yes, files and photos can be shared in a conversation. They're stored in the sender's Talk folder in Nextcloud.
Good to know. And can I pin an important message?
Yes, moderators can pin a message so it shows at the top of the conversation.
Nice. I'll pin the invoice process.
Good, thanks! A calm morning so far. Hope the warehouse is calm too.
Never, but we survive. Thanks for the help!
Hi there, hope your week is going well!
Hi! It is, thanks. How can we help?
Sofia, finance team at Lindqvist & Berg, in case you have several Sofias.
We do, actually, so thanks! What's up?
Month-end closing is coming, so I'm getting our sharing routine in order.
Good timing. How do you usually send documents to clients?
Links, our company policy prefers links over email attachments.
Mostly invoices and statements, almost every day.
Got it. Anything we should know about your setup?
Yes, that's why I'm writing. Our administrator turned on an enforced expiration date for public share links: they default to 7 days and can't be set beyond 14 days.
Thanks Sofia, noted on your account.
Fine by me, we mostly share invoices with clients for a few days.
Understood. Is there anything you'd like to set up today?
Yes, a small thing: can I switch the interface to Swedish? Some colleagues prefer it.
Yes, each person can choose their language in Personal settings, under Personal info, in the Language field.
The Locale field right below it controls date and number formats, so you can pick Swedish there too.
Do I have to log out for the change to apply?
No, the page reloads in the new language right away.
Great. That's all for today. Thanks!
You're welcome, have a good afternoon Sofia.
Good morning Sofia! What can we do for you?
It's audit season for us, so a busy few weeks ahead.
Sounds intense. How can we help you get ready?
I'm putting together all the documents the auditors asked for. Ledgers, bank statements, contracts.
Do you keep them in one folder?
Yes, I made a folder called 'Audit 2026' with subfolders per topic.
That's a clean structure, easy for anyone to find their way.
The external auditors arrive next week and will need the 'Audit 2026' folder for about a month.
Okay, let us know if you need help preparing the share.
Will do. Can I see how big the folder is?
Yes, the size column in the Files list shows the total for each folder, and the Details sidebar shows it too.
That's fine, nothing to worry about.
Also, we got the storage upgrade approved, thanks for that.
You're welcome! Glad it went through.
Another question: some scans are sideways. Can I rotate PDFs in Nextcloud?
The built-in viewer shows PDFs but doesn't edit and save them. Rotating is best done in a PDF tool on your computer.
If they're in a folder the desktop client syncs, the fixed file goes up automatically when you save it.
Great. I think that's all for now.
Good luck with the audit preparations!
Good morning! Sofia from Lindqvist & Berg.
Good morning Sofia! How can we help today?
I want to set up a calendar for our closing deadlines, so the team stops asking me when things are due.
Good idea. In the Calendar app, click '+ New calendar' and call it something like 'Finance deadlines'.
Done. Can I share it with the 'finance' group?
Yes, use the three dots next to the calendar, then 'Share', and search for the group.
They should only see it, not change it.
Then leave 'can edit' unticked for the group.
Perfect. Can I make repeating events? Month-end closing is always on the last working day.
Yes, in the event's repeat options you can set a monthly rule. For 'last working day' rules you may need to adjust single dates by hand around holidays.
That's fine, I'll check them once a quarter.
Can people get a reminder the day before?
You can add a reminder to each event, for example one day before. Whether colleagues get it too depends on how reminders are set up on your instance, so best to test with one person first.
If they sync the calendar to their computer or phone with CalDAV, the events appear there too. For Outlook on Windows that usually needs an extra sync tool.
Most of them just use the browser, so that's OK.
Then they'll see it in the Calendar app straight away.
Can I give the calendar a colour?
Yes, click the coloured dot next to its name and pick a colour.
Green, the colour of money. Ha.
You're welcome, Sofia. Good luck with the closing!
Hello! Sofia Lindqvist here, I work in finance at Lindqvist & Berg.
Hello Sofia, welcome! How can we help?
Our company has been on your Nextcloud for a while, but the finance team is only joining now.
Great to have you. Has your IT team created your accounts already?
Yes, Erik from IT set them up this morning. Five accounts.
Perfect. What would you like help with first?
We need one place for the whole team's files, not five separate folders.
The usual approach is a folder shared with a group. Is there a Finance group already?
I can see one called 'finance' when I search in the sharing field.
Then create a folder, for example 'Finance shared', open the Sharing tab in the Details sidebar and share it with the 'finance' group.
Done. Will the others see it right away?
Yes, it shows up in their Files the next time they open it.
Can I stop them from sharing it further with other people?
Yes, in the advanced settings of the group share you can turn off the share permission.
Done. What about the old files on our network drive?
The easiest way is the desktop client: put the files into the synced 'Finance shared' folder and they go up in the background.
Do all five need the desktop client?
Not necessarily. The web interface is enough for many people. The client is handy if you work with files all day.
Then the client is worth it. It's available for Windows, macOS and Linux.
Then the Windows installer from the Nextcloud website is the one. Erik might prefer to install it for you.
I'll ask him. Thanks for the quick start!
You're welcome, Sofia. Have a great first week!
Hi, Sofia from Lindqvist & Berg finance.
Hi Sofia! What can we do for you?
A billing question for once, since I'm the one paying your invoices now.
We'd like to switch from credit card to bank transfer.
Sure. With bank transfer we move you to yearly invoicing. Is that OK?
Yearly works, our budget is yearly anyway.
Great. Should the invoice keep the same billing address and VAT number?
Same address. But please add our purchase order number on each invoice, PO-2026-118.
Added. It will appear on the next invoice.
Your current card period ends on 1 June, so the first yearly invoice will be issued then.
Can you email it to our invoices mailbox instead of me?
Saved as the billing email. You stay as the contact person.
Perfect. Do you send a reminder before the next one?
Yes, we send a reminder a month before the renewal.
Good. Can I download old invoices somewhere?
Yes, in the customer portal under Billing, all past invoices are there as PDF.
No, that's all. Have a nice day.
Hi! Sofia here, with a mobile app question.
Colleagues collect paper receipts on trips. Can they scan them straight into Nextcloud with their phones?
Yes. In the Nextcloud mobile app, the '+' button has a 'Scan document' option.
Yes, you can save the scan as a PDF, and several pages can go into one file.
Great. Can they pick the folder?
Yes, it saves into the folder they are in when they tap '+', so they go to the right folder first.
We have a 'Receipts' folder in Finance shared.
Then they open that folder in the app and scan from there.
Does the text get recognised, so I can copy amounts?
The scan is an image inside the PDF, so I wouldn't count on being able to copy the text.
OK, we just need the picture anyway.
Can the app send photos up automatically? One colleague photographs receipts with the camera instead.
Yes, the auto upload feature can do that for a camera folder. Just be aware it takes every photo in that folder, personal ones included.
Probably wise for a work account. Scanning from the app is cleaner.
Hello, quick question about the desktop client.
On my laptop the Nextcloud icon in the taskbar shows a yellow sign, and some files don't sync.
Let's look. If you click the icon, does it show a message?
It says some files were not synced because of their name.
That usually means a file name with characters Windows doesn't allow, or a name ending with a space or a dot.
Let me check... yes, a colleague on a Mac saved a file with a colon in the name.
That explains it. Macs allow colons, Windows doesn't. Renaming the file fixes it.
Renamed it in the browser. The yellow sign is gone.
Great. The client should pick it up now.
It did. Is there a way to avoid this?
The easiest is to agree in the team to avoid characters like : ? * and quotes in file names.
I'll add that to our team guidelines.
While I have you: the client keeps asking to update itself. Is that safe?
Yes, client updates are fine to install. Your settings and folder setup stay as they are.
No. It's been a busy month, sorry for all the messages.
No need to apologise, that's what we're here for.
Thanks! Things should calm down in December.
Hope so! Enjoy the quieter weeks then.
Good afternoon! How can we help?
Tomas here, I run the IT for Novak Studio. We're a 3D visualisation studio in Brno, twelve people.
Hi Tomas! Nice to meet you. What are you working on?
We're reorganising the network. The studio moves to a new office building next month and I'm redoing the setup.
It is. We want everyone to reach Nextcloud through our own domain, files.novakstudio.example.
You can use your own domain. Point it to us with a CNAME record and we'll add it to your instance with a certificate.
Good. We also want our own entry point in front of it, for security reasons.
Understood, what do you have in mind?
We put an nginx reverse proxy in front of our Nextcloud. What body size limit do we need for big uploads?
Nextcloud uploads big files in chunks of at most 10 MiB, so a client_max_body_size of 10 MiB on the proxy is enough.
Also make sure the proxy passes on the original host and protocol headers, and tell us the proxy's IP so we can add it as a trusted proxy.
Right, X-Forwarded-For and X-Forwarded-Proto. I'll send the IP.
Thanks, as soon as we have it we'll add it to the trusted proxies on your instance.

Hello Hana. Do you want to exchange files between the two servers?
Yes. Their data contact, Pavel Král, shared a folder from their server with me this morning, called 'terrasonda-raw'. I got a notification.
That's a federated share. Accept it in the notification and the folder appears in your Files like any other share.
Accepted, it's there. He shared it with our two analysts, Jiří and Lenka, too.
Good, then they'll each get the same notification.
Each week the analysts will copy the new sensor bundles into that folder for the institute. Each bundle is between 300 and 450 MB.
Okay. Make sure Pavel gave them edit rights, otherwise they can only read the folder.
He did, Jiří already created a test subfolder.
Pavel will put the cleaned data back in another subfolder.
Unrelated: our office printer scans to email. Can it scan into Nextcloud instead?
Many printers can scan to a WebDAV or SMB location, and Nextcloud speaks WebDAV. Check the printer's manual and we can help with the details.
I'll look the model up later.
Last: fieldwork starts next week, I'll be mostly offline until mid-June.
Thanks for the heads-up. Another admin can contact us while you're away.
Hi, back from the field! Mostly good news.
Welcome back Hana! What's the not-so-good part?
Not bad, just admin: we moved to a new office, so our invoice address changed.
Congratulations on the new office. Send me the new address and I'll update your billing profile.
Updated. The next yearly invoice will go to the new address.
Thanks. The team loved Talk in the field by the way. The WhatsApp chaos is over.
Can I make a Talk conversation just for the field team?
Yes, create a group conversation and add the Field group as a participant.
Nice. And Marek wants to know if Deck cards can have due dates.
Yes, each card can have a due date, which is shown on the card.
He'll be happy. How much storage are we using?
You're at 310 GB of your 1 TB.
More than I thought, the field photos add up.
Photos and audio recordings do. You have plenty of room for now.
Okay. We're planning a second field season in August.
Very. Is any downtime planned in August?
Only the usual monthly maintenance window, the first Saturday of the month from 06:00 to 07:30 UTC.
Fine, the team won't be working then anyway.
Hi, two things, one of them a request.

For the August season each coordinator wants a separate calendar per field site, plus subscriptions to the regional weather and public holiday calendars. Marek tried to create more and got an error saying he had reached the limit.
I see. The number of calendars per account is capped on the server, and raising it is a server-level change that needs platform team approval. I've opened ticket SUP-5318 for you.
We'd need around 40 each, to be safe.
I've put 40 in the request. The platform team decides the final value; they usually answer within a week.
Okay. The other thing: Jiří says copying the sensor bundles into the institute's folder keeps failing. Small files work, but the big bundles fail after about half a minute.
Thanks, I've noted that. Do they fail every time?
Almost every time. Pavel says the institute's server looks fine on their side.
Can you tell me roughly when Jiří last tried?
Thanks, I'll pass that to our technicians.
Thanks. Unrelated: Ines asks if she can change her display name, it shows 'ines.h'.
She can change it herself in Personal settings, in the Full name field under Personal info.
It's hot here, 36 degrees in the wetlands last week.
Bye Hana, we'll update you on SUP-5318 soon.
Hello! Season two is done, now comes the analysis.
Hello Hana, congratulations on finishing! How can I help?
I created a folder 'Interviews-2026' in my account, with a subfolder per village holding the audio and transcripts. I've shared it with Marek and Ines, they do the coding of the interviews.
Good. Did you give them edit rights?
Yes, they need to add their notes.
Can Nextcloud transcribe audio? We have 60 hours of interviews in Czech.
Your plan doesn't include the AI assistant features, so there's no transcription on your instance. Most teams use a separate transcription tool and upload the text.
Okay, we'll keep using our tool.
The site calendars are working great now, by the way, every site has its own.
In October I'm at a workshop in Vienna, 13 to 17 October.
Noted. Do you want someone else to have admin rights while you're away?
As an admin you can add Marek to the admin group on the Accounts page.
Done, Marek is an admin now.
Our funder wants the final report in December. Just thinking ahead.
Good luck with the writing! Let us know if you need anything.
Hi, a small mishap and some admin stuff.
Marek deleted the 'Village-B' subfolder in Interviews-2026 yesterday, 10 November, by mistake. He thought he was cleaning up his own folders.
Oh no. Do you need it back right away?
Not today, Ines needs it for her coding next week. I'm off to the field station for a few days and will sort it out when I'm back.
Admin stuff: Lenka leaves at the end of November. What should we do with her account?
You could disable it after her last day; her files stay in place and you can enable it again later if needed.
Fine, we'll disable it on 1 December.
When is our yearly invoice due?
Your yearly invoice in CZK is issued on 1 March, the anniversary of your start.
Okay, so nothing before year end.
Our new website links to a press kit folder in Nextcloud. Can the link stay valid forever?
A public link with no expiration date stays valid until you delete it, as long as no expiration is enforced, and none is on your instance.
Great. Thanks for everything this year.
It's been a pleasure, Hana. Good luck at the field station!
Hola! Diego Álvarez here, from Alvarez Sound Studio in Valencia. We just signed up for the Studio plan.
Welcome Diego! Happy to have you. What would you like to set up first?
We're six people: me, Rafa and Lucía who do the engineering, Marco on video, Ana on bookings and Iker who helps with everything. I need accounts for all of them.
You can create them yourself as the admin: open the Accounts page from your avatar menu and click 'New account'. Your plan includes up to 10 accounts.
Ok, found it. Should I make groups too?
Groups help a lot once you share folders. Many studios use one group per role, for example 'engineering' and 'office'.
Makes sense. Engineering for Rafa, Lucía and me, office for Ana and Iker, and Marco in both I guess.
That works. A user can be in as many groups as you like.
Can we use our own domain? We'd like cloud.alvarezsound.es instead of the default address.
Yes. Create a CNAME record for cloud.alvarezsound.es pointing to studio-4187.hosted-nc.net and tell us when it's done. We issue the certificate automatically.
I'll ask our web guy to add it today.
Great. Once DNS has propagated it usually takes us less than an hour to switch it over.
And the invoices, do they come by email?
Yes, to the billing address you entered at signup. You can also download them from the customer portal under Billing.
We need the VAT number on them, ESB98765432.
Added. All future invoices will show it, and I've regenerated the March invoice too.
Perfect. Last thing for now, is there a mobile app? Ana does bookings from her phone.
Yes, the Nextcloud app for Android and iOS. She logs in with the server address and her account.
De nada! Write to us any time.
Oh, the CNAME is done already, our web guy was fast.
I can see it resolving. Your new address will be live within the hour, we'll send a confirmation email.
Hi, Diego from Alvarez Sound again. Quick one about uploads.
Lucía uploaded a 1.4 GB bounce of the Marea EP through the browser yesterday and it worked fine. What's the biggest file we can push through the browser?
On the Studio plan the browser upload limit is 2 GB per file. Your instance is configured that way on our side.
Good to know. Our full session archives are way bigger, but that's for later, we haven't finished the Lumen album yet.
Understood. Just ask us when you get there.
Another thing. We want to send mixes to clients without making them create accounts.
You can share a file or folder by link from the share icon next to it. Anyone with the link can open it.
Can I put a password on it? Some of these are unreleased tracks.
Yes, in the share options of the link you can set a password and an expiration date.
Nice. I'll do 14 days expiry for client previews.
Also we started using Deck for the release schedule. Can Ana see the board without being an editor?
When you share a board you choose per user or group whether they can edit, share or manage it. Leave edit unticked and she can only view.
Ah ok, so I share it with the office group read-only.
Rafa keeps asking if we can get a bigger plan later without moving all the files.
Yes, upgrades happen in place. Files, shares and accounts stay where they are, only the limits change.
Glad to hear it. Anything else today?
You're welcome Diego, good luck with the album.
Morning. Was there an outage last night? Nobody could log in around 23:00.
Good morning Diego. Yes, sorry about that. We had a database failover between 22:48 and 23:06 CEST. Everything is back and no data was lost.
Ok. Rafa was doing a late upload and thought he broke something.
Not his fault. If an upload was interrupted, it's worth checking that the file is complete and uploading it again if not.
Great. We posted the incident report on the status page this morning.
Another thing while I have you. We're setting up Studio B this week.
Nice! What do you need there?
The mixing Mac in Studio B is still on macOS Big Sur 11. We can't upgrade it, the plugin licences are tied to that install. For now we just open Nextcloud in Safari on it.
Understood, the web interface works in any current browser.
Safari on it sometimes shows the login page twice. Is that us or you?
That's usually an old cookie. Clear the website data for cloud.alvarezsound.es in Safari's settings and log in again.
Also Marco wants to know if he can edit the video cue sheets online. They're .xlsx files.
Yes, your plan includes Nextcloud Office. Click the file and it opens in the browser editor.
Can two people edit the same sheet at the same time?
Yes, collaborative editing works, you'll see each other's cursors.
Cool, Marco and Ana will love that.
No, the rest is cables and acoustic panels, not your department.
Ha, good luck with the panels!
Hi, we're getting close to full. The admin page says 1.7 TB of 2 TB used.
Hi Diego. That's 85%. Do you want to look at what's using the space, or at a storage add-on?
Both maybe. How much is extra storage?
Add-ons come in 1 TB blocks at 18 EUR per month each, billed with your plan.
Ok. Before buying, Rafa is cleaning up. He says our calendars and contacts eat into the file storage quota, so he's been deleting the old gig calendars from 2024.
Understood. For finding the big items, the Files app can sort by size: open a folder and click the Size column header.
Found it. The Raw Takes folder is 900 GB on its own.
That's usually the biggest win. Some studios keep raw takes on an external drive once a project is mastered.
We'll talk about that. The Marea EP is mastered, so its raw takes could go.
Make sure you have a copy you trust before deleting anything.
Of course, Lucía has the backup drive.
Also, Ana deleted the old bookings calendar by accident last week and recreated it. No harm done.
Can I see who uses the most space per person?
Yes, on the Accounts page each account shows its used space next to its quota.
Rafa is at 600 GB. Of course.
Let's do one add-on block now so we're not stressed.
Done: your plan now has 3 TB. The add-on appears on your next invoice, prorated for July.
Hola, since the weekend something changed with our MP3s.
Hi Diego. We upgraded your instance to Nextcloud 32.0.1 on Sunday 20 September. What are you seeing?
The Files app used to show the album cover as the thumbnail for every MP3 in the Releases folder. Now they're all plain music note icons.
Thanks for the details. The files themselves open and play normally?
Yes, they play fine, Rafa checked a few. But we browse releases by cover, it's how the whole team finds things.
Understood. That behaviour changed in a recent version, it isn't something on your side.
Can you turn the covers back on for us? It really matters for how we work.
That's a server setting that our platform team has to review. I've opened ticket SUP-6214 with your request and the reason.
Usually one to two weeks. They'll look at performance on your instance first and you'll get an email when it's decided.
Talk calls feel smoother actually. We did a remote session with a singer in Madrid last Friday.
Nice to hear. Was the audio good enough for a session?
For talkback yes. For recording we use other software, Talk is just for communication.
That's how most studios use it.
Also, can we have a shared folder that everyone sees, not owned by one person?
Yes, your plan includes Team folders (group folders). I can create one for you. What name and which groups?
Call it 'Studio Shared', engineering and office groups, everyone can edit.
Created. It appears in everyone's Files root within a few minutes.
Anything else I can help with?
Noted on SUP-6214. Have a good day Diego.
Hi, we hired a seventh person, Nerea, our new assistant engineer.
Congratulations! You have 10 accounts on the Studio plan, so you can add her right away from the Accounts page.
Done. Can I make her inherit the engineering stuff?
Put her in the engineering group and she gets every share and team folder that group has.
Nice. She sees Studio Shared already.
We also want a booking form for new artists. Name, email, what they want to record, dates.
The Forms app does that. Create a form, add the questions, and share it with a public link.
Can the answers go into a spreadsheet?
Yes, in the form's results view you can export them as a spreadsheet or link them to a sheet file in your Files.
About billing, the October invoice has the 3 TB add-on twice?
Let me check... You're right, there's a duplicate line. I've issued a credit note for 18 EUR, it will show on the November invoice.
Thanks for fixing it so fast.
One more: can Nerea use the app on her Android phone with her account?
Yes, same as everyone. Install the Nextcloud app, enter cloud.alvarezsound.es and log in.
Great, welcome Nerea to the team from us!
Ha, I'll tell her. Hasta luego.
Good morning, Ingrid Halvorsen here, operations manager at Fjordline Consulting in Bergen. We're moving from Dropbox to your hosted Nextcloud.
Good morning Ingrid, welcome! How many people will use it?
Fourteen staff. Our IT person Henrik Dahl will help me with the admin side.
Great. Your Business plan covers up to 25 accounts and 5 TB. Would you like Henrik to be an admin too?
Yes please. His account is henrik.dahl.
You can do it yourself: on the Accounts page, add him to the admin group. Admins can manage accounts and apps.
Done. How do we move the Dropbox data?
Most teams install the desktop client, point it to a new folder and copy the Dropbox files into it. It uploads them in the background.
We have about 600 GB. Will that take long?
It depends on your office upload speed. On a 100 Mbit line, 600 GB takes roughly 14 hours of continuous uploading.
We'll start it on a Friday evening then.
Can we put our logo on the login page?
Yes, in Administration settings under Theming you can upload a logo and background and set your brand colour.
Lovely. Our colour is a dark teal.
Pick it in the colour field there, it applies to everyone right away.
And can we keep our folder structure Clients/Projects/Year?
Yes, Nextcloud keeps whatever folder structure you copy in.
Good. Henrik will want to know about backups.
We back up every instance nightly and keep the backups for 30 days. Restores from backup go through a support ticket.
You're welcome Ingrid, have a good migration weekend.
Hi, Ingrid from Fjordline. The migration went fine, everything is in.
Next step: our insurer wants two-factor authentication for everyone by the end of the year.
That's a common requirement. Your plan includes the TOTP two-factor app, which works with authenticator apps on a phone.
Which authenticator app do you recommend?
Any standard TOTP app works, for example the ones from Microsoft, Google, or open source ones like Aegis.
Henrik is worried about the laptops. Everyone has the desktop client syncing.
Enabling 2FA won't affect your desktop client, it keeps working with your normal password, so you can roll it out without touching the laptops.
Oh good, that makes it much easier. We'll do the web logins first then.
Can I make it mandatory, or does every person turn it on themselves?
Each person can turn it on in their personal Security settings, and an admin can also enforce it for everyone or for selected groups.
We'll start voluntary and enforce it later in the year.
That gives people time to get used to it.
Unrelated: Sigrid can't see the 'Tenders 2026' folder I shared with her.
Can you check the share in the sidebar of the folder, under Sharing, that her name is listed?
Ah, I shared it with Sigrid Moe from the other office, not Sigrid Lunde. Fixed.
Happens all the time with same first names!
Thanks. Last thing, the invoice should go to accounts@fjordline.no now.
Updated. The May invoice will go there.
Hi, a question about the profile pages.
Some staff filled in phone numbers and roles in their personal info. Who can see that?
Each field has a visibility setting next to it in Personal info, so each person chooses who can see it.
Okay. Mikkel Berg asked me about it. He's very privacy-minded, and yesterday he set all his profile fields to Private in his personal settings, every single one.
That's his choice, and fine to do.
Fair enough. We also want a company phone list. Can we just use the Contacts app?
Yes, Contacts can hold shared address books. You can also create a separate address book and share it with a group.
We'll try. Another thing: the office printer scans to email. Can it scan into Nextcloud instead?
If the printer supports scanning to WebDAV, yes. Use your server address with /remote.php/dav/files/ACCOUNT/ and a dedicated account for the scanner.
Henrik will look at that, he said the printer is from 2019 so who knows.
Worth checking its manual for WebDAV or SMB support.
And we want a team calendar for the consultants' site visits.
Create a calendar in the Calendar app and share it with the consultants group. You can let them edit it.
One more: can we disable the Photos app? Nobody uses it and it confuses people.
Yes, in the Apps page an admin can disable it. It disappears from the top menu for everyone.
Hello, we have two people leaving at the end of August. How should we handle their accounts?
Hi Ingrid. Usually you first make sure their important files are handed over to a colleague. Who are they?
Erik Solheim and a summer intern, Nora.
For Erik, if he owns client folders, the admin can transfer his files to a colleague, or we can run that for you.
Good, Henrik will handle that. Henrik also said deleting accounts is no risk: deleted users go to a trash and can be restored for 30 days, so he's not worried about mistakes.
Okay. For billing, removed accounts stop counting toward your seats from the day they're removed.
No, your Business plan is a flat price up to 25 accounts. Seats only matter if you go over 25.
Ah, right, I forgot. We're at 14 anyway.
Nora has a shared link to the 'Summer project' folder that external partners use. What happens to that?
Links belong to the person who created them. If the files move to someone else, it's safest to create a new link and send it to the partners.
Okay, I'll tell her colleague to make a new one.
Separate question. Can we see who last edited a document?
Yes, the Activity tab in the file's sidebar shows recent changes and who made them.
The Versions tab next to it lists earlier versions of the file.
Let us know if you'd like us to run the transfer for Erik.
Hi, Ingrid here. A slightly unusual request today.
Hi Ingrid, unusual is fine. What's up?
We run seabed survey projects. Two rugged laptops travel on survey vessels and sync results with the desktop client when they're back in port.
Interesting setup. How often do they connect?
Sometimes once a year. One vessel, the MV Kystfalk, is chartered abroad and those laptops can be away for over a year.
I see. Since Nextcloud 30, app passwords that are not used for a long time are cleaned up automatically, so a laptop that's been away very long might need to log in again.
That's exactly what Henrik read. When they come back, the crew is tired and nobody remembers the passwords. Can you keep the app passwords longer on our instance?
That's a server setting that needs approval. I've opened ticket SUP-6271 for our platform team with your reason.
Thank you. Can it be done for just those laptops?
The setting applies to the whole instance, so the platform and security teams will weigh that.
You'll get an email once it's decided, usually within two weeks.
Good. Meanwhile, the laptops' accounts are survey1 and survey2, if that helps.
Other topic: can we get a monthly usage report? Management likes numbers.
The admin overview shows used storage and active users. We can also email you a monthly summary if you like.
Done, the first one comes on 1 October.
Great. And the 'Site visits' calendar now has 300 events, is that a problem?
Not at all, calendars handle many thousands of events.
Thank you Ingrid, I'll keep you posted on SUP-6271.
Hi. A Word document seems stuck: it says it's locked by Sigrid but she's on holiday.
Hi Ingrid. Which file is it?
I see a stale editing session from Friday. I've cleared it, you can open it now.
Good. That can happen when someone closes the laptop lid in the middle of editing.
That sounds like Sigrid before a holiday, yes.
Also, is there maintenance coming? Henrik saw something on the status page.
Yes, on Sunday 25 October from 05:00 to 06:00 CET we'll upgrade the database servers. Your instance may be unavailable for up to 15 minutes in that window.
That's fine, nobody works Sunday morning.
Thanks for the monthly report, management liked it.
Can I add Henrik to the report email?
We'd also like a second team folder for HR, only visible to me and Henrik.
Created 'HR', shared with the two of you only. Nobody else sees it.
Hi, a few small things before year-end.
We're adding three new consultants in December. Do we need to change the plan?
No, you'll be at 15 of 25 accounts, so the Business plan still covers it.
Good. Their start date is 1 December, can I create accounts now and send the welcome emails later?
Yes. Create the accounts without an email, then add the email address on their first day to send the welcome mail.
Clever. Also, the insurer deadline is coming. I'm turning two-factor on for my own account next week, then everyone else in December.
Sounds like a good plan to test it yourself first.
I'll use Aegis on my phone.
Good choice. Keep the backup codes somewhere safe, away from the phone.
Will do. Henrik asked whether the December invoice can be split by department.
We can't split one invoice, but we can add a cost centre reference on it. What should it say?
Done, it will be on the December invoice.
Lastly, any news on our survey laptops ticket?
SUP-6271 was decided last month, the confirmation went to your email on 2 October. The details are on your account.
Ah right, I saw a mail from you then, I'll dig it up.
That's everything. Thanks for the help this year.
Thanks, god helg to you too.
Hello, I'm Wei Chen, I run Lanterna Translations in Rotterdam. We signed up yesterday for the Team plan.
Welcome Wei! What does your team look like?
Nine people in-house and around twenty freelance translators who come and go.
Got it. Your Team plan includes 15 full accounts and 1 TB. How would you like to handle the freelancers?
Each freelancer only needs the folder for the client project they work on.
A common setup is a folder per client project, shared with only the people working on it.
Ok. Should freelancers get full accounts?
If they need to log in often, a full account is simplest. For one-off jobs, a share link to the project folder can be enough.
Most are long-term, but a few are one-off. We'll do both.
My colleague Joost van Dijk does operations. He should be an admin.
Add him to the admin group on the Accounts page.
Done. Our main tool is a translation memory app on Windows, it reads files from a folder.
Then the desktop client is a good fit, it keeps a local folder in sync with Nextcloud.
Great. Can I set the interface to Dutch for Joost and English for me?
Yes, each person picks their language in Personal settings.
Perfect. What's the address of our server?
lanterna-6619.hosted-nc.net. You can add your own domain later if you like.
Hi, Wei here. Joost wants to mount Nextcloud as a drive in Windows Explorer for the old QA tool.
Hi Wei. That works with WebDAV. The address is https://lanterna-6619.hosted-nc.net/remote.php/dav/files/USERNAME/ with his own username.
He did that with 'Map network drive' and it connected.
Yes, but it's really slow. Opening a folder with 200 files takes almost a minute.
Windows' built-in WebDAV can be slow with big folders. How is he logging in?
With his normal password. I suggested an app password, but Joost says an app password for WebDAV only adds security, it makes no difference to speed, so he didn't bother.
Okay. Is the QA tool reading the files directly from the drive?
Yes, it opens one file at a time.
Smaller folders also help Windows Explorer load faster.
We'll try to split the archive by year.
Different topic: Amira wants a shared glossary that freelancers can read but not change.
Share the glossary folder with the freelancers group and untick the edit permission. They'll be able to read and download.
Last thing: May invoice. We changed our company address to Wijnhaven 88.
Updated, the address will appear from the May invoice.
Good morning. One of our freelancers, Lotte, says the login page makes her wait several seconds every time.
Good morning Wei. Did she type her password wrong a few times?
Yes, she had the old password saved in her browser and it tried it again and again.
That explains it. Nextcloud slows down login attempts after repeated failures to protect against password guessing.

Yes, it clears on its own after a while once the failed attempts stop. Brute-force protection locks the user account everywhere, on every device, until that delay expires, so she should stop trying for a bit.
Ok, I'll tell her to take a coffee break.
Good idea. And update the saved password in her browser.
Done. Also, we want our own domain now: cloud.lanterna-translations.nl.
Create a CNAME for cloud.lanterna-translations.nl pointing to lanterna-6619.hosted-nc.net and let us know.
Will the old address keep working?
Yes, it will redirect to the new one, so old links keep working.
Amira asked whether we can have Talk for client calls.
Talk is included in your plan. You can create a conversation and invite guests by link.
Right, guests join from the link in their browser.
Hi, a question about the admin overview page.
Joost noticed a line about background jobs and the last time they ran. What is that?
Nextcloud runs regular maintenance tasks in the background, like cleanup and sending notifications. On your instance background jobs run via system cron every 15 minutes, that's set up on our side.
So he doesn't have to do anything?
Correct, nothing to do. The page just shows when the last run happened.
Good. We also started using the Calendar for client appointments.
Nice. Are you sharing one calendar or each person their own?
One shared 'Client meetings' calendar for the in-house team, plus personal ones.
Can I subscribe to Dutch public holidays?
Yes, in Calendar you can add a subscription by URL, or use the holiday calendars offered there.
Amira's calendar on her iPhone doesn't show the shared calendar.
On iOS, add the account under Settings > Calendar > Accounts as a CalDAV account with your server address and an app password.
She did that and now it shows up.
Billing question: can we switch to yearly billing?
Yes, yearly billing gives you two months free. It starts at your next renewal on 18 September.
Done. You'll get the yearly invoice on 18 September.
Hi, Wei from Lanterna. A request about calendars.
Some of our clients are law firms. Their meeting entries contain confidential case names.
When we delete an appointment, their compliance people want it really gone quickly, not sitting in a calendar trash bin for weeks.
I see. How long the calendar trash bin keeps deleted events is a server setting on our side.
Can you shorten it for us? A lot.
That needs approval from our platform team. I've opened ticket SUP-6338 with your reason.
Usually about two weeks. You'll get an email when it's decided.
Fine. Does it affect only the calendar, not our files trash bin?
Your request is only about the calendar trash bin, so that's what the ticket covers.
Good, the file trash bin is useful for us.
Unrelated: Joost wants to know if we're on the latest version.
Your instance runs Nextcloud 32.0.1, upgraded on 20 September.
Also, Amira will be on maternity leave from November. Her account should stay.
Nothing to do then, the account stays as it is. If someone needs her files while she's away, she can share them before she leaves.
She'll share the 'Client meetings' notes folder with me.
You're welcome Wei, I'll keep you posted on SUP-6338.
Hi. One of our long-term freelancers, Paolo Rinaldi, is leaving at the end of November.
Hi Wei, sorry to lose him. How can we help?
He owns a lot of project folders that others use. We want all his files moved to my account when he leaves.
We can transfer the ownership of his files to you, including the shares he created. Should we do it on 30 November?
Yes, 30 November in the evening please.
Noted. I'll schedule it for 30 November at 18:00.
Paolo told me he already cleaned up a bit. Last week he deleted his old 'Glossaries-2024' folder from his account, it's in his trash bin now.
Okay, thanks for letting us know.
We'll probably still need that one, there are client glossaries in it.
What happens to his account after the transfer?
That's your choice. You can keep it disabled for a while or delete it.
Different thing: our 1 TB is at 640 GB. Should I worry?
Not yet. At this pace you have several months. We'll warn you at 90%.
Also, Joost asked to make the Talk notifications quieter on his desktop.
In the Talk conversation settings he can set notifications to 'only when mentioned'.
You're welcome Wei, have a good weekend.

questions.question: How do I go back to an older version of a drawing I overwrote?
questions.gold: Open the file's Details sidebar, go to the Versions tab and click the restore (circular arrow) button next to the version you want; clicking the version's timestamp downloads it instead.
questions.must_not_claim: restoring an older version is not possible or must be requested from support

questions.question: Once a file is more than a month old, how many of its old versions does Nextcloud keep?
questions.gold: After the first 30 days Nextcloud keeps one version per week; versions never use more than 50% of the user's free space (the oldest are deleted beyond that), and a version you give a name to is excluded from expiration.
questions.must_not_claim: every version is kept forever

questions.question: Where do I get backup codes for two-factor login, and can I use the same code more than once?
questions.gold: In Personal Settings, under the Second-factor Auth settings, choose 'Generate backup codes'; each backup code can be used only once (one-time-use) and they should be kept somewhere safe, away from the second-factor device.
questions.must_not_claim: a backup code can be used more than once

questions.question: I'm back from my trip. Can I still restore the Q3-contracts folder from the trash bin?
questions.gold: Probably not: the folder was deleted on 2 October 2026, about 46 days ago, and with the standard settings deleted files stay in the trash bin for 30 days before being permanently deleted, so it has most likely been removed; it can only come back from a backup.
questions.must_not_claim: the folder is still in the trash bin and can simply be restored
sources: nextcloud-32-user-manual p.30 (3.3.3 How the deleted files app manages storage space)

questions.question: Why is my storage almost full when I barely upload anything myself?
questions.gold: Files that other people upload through her upload-enabled public link ('Client drop' on Clients/Incoming) count against her own quota, so the clients' scans and photos fill her storage.
questions.must_not_claim: files uploaded by other people do not count against her quota

questions.question: Can I create a public link for the auditors that stays valid for 30 days?
questions.gold: No: her administrator enforces a 14-day maximum on public link expiration, and users cannot set an expiration date further than the enforced one; she can set up to 14 days and extend the date again later when it is close to expiring (the expiration is counted from the current date).
questions.must_not_claim: she can set the link to expire in 30 days

questions.question: Will Nextcloud ever delete old versions of my budget spreadsheet on its own?
questions.gold: Yes: the versions app expires old versions automatically (after 30 days it keeps one per week, and it never lets versions use more than 50% of the free space); naming a version excludes it from expiration.
questions.must_not_claim: versions are kept forever unless he deletes them himself

questions.question: Do the files in my trash bin count toward my quota?
questions.gold: No: deleted files still in the trash bin do not count against the quota, so she does not need to empty it every evening (the trash bin itself is limited to 50% of the available free space).
questions.must_not_claim: files in the trash bin count against her quota

questions.question: Is our reverse proxy body limit still big enough for chunked uploads?
questions.gold: No: since Nextcloud 32 the default maximum chunk size is 100 MiB (it used to be 10 MiB), so the 10 MiB client_max_body_size on his nginx proxy is too small and should be raised to at least 100 MiB.
questions.must_not_claim: the current 10 MiB proxy limit is enough because chunks are at most 10 MiB
sources: nextcloud-32-admin-manual p.22 (release notes: Maximum chunk size)

questions.question: How long do my deleted files stay in the trash bin before they are gone for good?
questions.gold: 90 days on her instance, because of her approved exception SUP-4411 (instead of the default 30 days); the trash bin space limit of 50% of the free space still applies.
questions.must_not_claim: her deleted files are kept for 30 days

questions.question: How long do my deleted files stay in the trash bin before they are gone for good?
questions.gold: 30 days, the default (his instance uses the standard trash bin settings); older deleted files, or the oldest ones when the trash exceeds 50% of the free space, are permanently deleted.
questions.must_not_claim: his deleted files are kept for 90 days

questions.question: How long are old versions of my files kept?
questions.gold: At least 365 days on his instance, because of his approved exception SUP-4302 ('365, auto'); only versions older than a year follow the normal automatic expiration rules.
questions.must_not_claim: his versions follow only the default expiration pattern with no one-year minimum

questions.question: How long are old versions of my files kept?

questions.question: Can I get on-demand virtual files on my MacBook, the way my colleagues have them on Windows?

questions.question: If I transfer ownership of my client folders to a colleague, where will they find them?

questions.question: I created an app password for my tablet last week but didn't write it down. Where can I see it again?

questions.must_not_claim: the existing app password can be looked up later in Personal settings > Security

questions.question: If we switch on server-side encryption, will our quota fill up faster?

questions.must_not_claim: encryption makes files about a third bigger and that extra counts against the quota

questions.question: My storage is almost full. Should I ask Daniel to stop sharing his footage folder with me to free up space?

questions.question: Would switching Joost's Windows drive mapping to an app password make it any faster?
